steps.instruction: Read the request and declared inputs. Extract each user journey with its actor, plus feature, environment, access, fixture and source-role policies. Bind surface routes when supplied. Ask when a journey has no known entry.

reads.when: when a surface map is declared
when templates, prior flows or unchecked coverage are declared

calls.purpose: Read the goal, surface map and declared flow evidence.

steps.instruction: Inspect existing flow names, case sheets, account aliases and seed namespaces. Reuse stable identities and history, but do not provision accounts or inspect secret values.

Create, update or reuse exactly one flow per journey. Write actor, precondition, input, bounded ordered UI actions, assertions, expected result, verification, fixture references and cleanup. Freeze access, fixtures and source roles; allocate distinct aliases and namespaces where required; tier every flow.

reads.when: when a surface map is bound
when a UAT template is supplied

calls.purpose: Persist the plan, machine case sheet and matching unit list.
calls.when: after all flow criteria are satisfied

steps.instruction: Write and validate the typed response after every planned flow passes. Report that no browser, sign-in or fixture operation has run.

calls.purpose: Run scripts/validate_operator.py for this bundle and records.
